nodes.description: Public address state variable initialized to msg.sender, acting as the contract owner/access-control authority.
Public uint state variable storing the last completed migration index; mutated by setCompleted.
Public function guarded by the restricted modifier that writes the completed parameter into last_completed_migration.
Modifier enforcing require(msg.sender == owner); behaves as an access-control wrapper around guarded functions.
Caller-controlled address used both for owner initialization and for the authorization check in the restricted modifier.
uint parameter of setCompleted whose value is written into the last_completed_migration state variable.
Authorization check require(msg.sender == owner) inside the restricted modifier; access-control decision point.
State-mutating assignment last_completed_migration = completed performed under the restricted modifier.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored directly into the owner state variable at construction, making the deployer the access-control authority derived from an untrusted input.
The untrusted caller address msg.sender flows into the require(msg.sender == owner) authorization predicate that decides whether execution continues.
The restricted modifier gates entry into setCompleted, so the caller comparison determines whether the function body executes.
The completed parameter is written into the last_completed_migration state variable.
The completed parameter is the value consumed by the state-mutating assignment represented by the unsafe operation node.
setCompleted executes the assignment to last_completed_migration once the restricted modifier has succeeded.

normalization_plan.reason: The completed parameter is only meaningful as an argument of setCompleted and can be normalized into that core function node.
